recognize_zh: 這顆細胞核染色質濃縮，分成約 3 個葉並以細絲（filament）相連，細胞質淡粉紅且布滿細小特異顆粒，是成熟的分節嗜中性球（segmented neutrophil）。
features: Mature granulocyte about 1.5 times the diameter of a red cell
Nucleus divided into approximately three lobes joined by thin chromatin filaments
Dense, coarsely clumped chromatin without nucleoli
Pale pink cytoplasm with abundant fine specific (neutrophilic) granules
Surrounding red cells show mild crenation, likely a drying artifact
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature neutrophil among red cells. The nucleus is segmented into approximately three lobes connected by thin filaments, with condensed chromatin, and the cytoplasm is pale with numerous fine specific granules. There is no toxic granulation, Döhle bodies or cytoplasmic vacuolation, and nuclear lobation is within the normal range (2-5 lobes). Findings are consistent with a normal segmented neutrophil.

ddx.vs: Band neutrophils have a continuous C- or S-shaped nucleus without true filamentous separation between lobes.
Eosinophils usually have bilobed nuclei and large refractile orange-red granules, unlike the fine lilac granules here.
Hypersegmented neutrophils have six or more lobes (or >5% with five lobes), whereas this cell has about three.
